login.title: Sign in
login.codeHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.recoveryHint: One of the recovery codes you saved when you set up the authenticator.
login.failed: The username, password or code is not correct.
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
login.unavailable: Ariva cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
login.codeNeeded: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.recoveryLeft: You signed in with a recovery code; {count} left. Generate new ones in Account security.

setup.title: Set up your account
setup.description: Your administrator gave you a temporary password. Choose your own and set up an authenticator app.
setup.passwordRules: 12 to 128 characters. Not a common or breached password, and without your username or the product name.
setup.totpIntro: Scan this code with an authenticator app (for example Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
setup.qrLabel: QR code to add Ariva to your authenticator app
setup.manualKey: Or enter this key by hand
setup.codeRefused: The code was not accepted. Check that the time on your phone is right and try the next code.
setup.recoveryIntro: Keep these codes somewhere safe, away from your phone. Each one signs you in once if you lose the authenticator. They are shown only now.
setup.copied: The codes are copied. Paste them somewhere safe, then copy something else so they do not stay on this computer's clipboard.
setup.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the codes and copy them yourself.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.description: This action needs a fresh code from your authenticator app.

user.signOutFailed: Ariva could not end your session on the server. Sign out again when the network is back, or close the browser.

account.title: Account security
account.description: Your password, your authenticator app and your recovery codes

password.title: Password
password.done: Your password is changed. Your other sessions are signed out.

totp.title: Authenticator app

totp.notEnrolled: No authenticator app is set up for your account yet.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: New codes replace the old ones, which stop working. Enter a code from your authenticator app to generate them.
